name: What happens at the end of the project from a management standpoint?

mainEntity.name: What happens at the end of the project from a management standpoint?

acceptedAnswer.text: Near completion, the project manager coordinates punchlist walks, manages final corrections, collects warranties and manuals, and oversees final inspections and closeout documentation.
